title: Q-ULTRA-uptime-COMMON-MODE: every tenant reads the same out-of-bounds uptime; fix the reading, not the tenants
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** 8 tenants read one identical out-of-bounds value for `uptime` (access-check:uptime, air-quality:uptime, blindspot:uptime, country-snapshot:uptime, free-tier-meter:uptime, loop-ledger:uptime)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status
**Status:** open

The second loop holds its per-tenant steps on this variable (SECOND-LOOP-2 common_mode): the fault is in the shared probe or path.

**Prediction:** tenant.uptime_distinct_values >= 2 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** retiring, rebuilding or changing any single tenant.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status` shows no key in common_mode.
